deadline.quote: Application deadline for Fall 2027 is December 1, 2026.

gre_general.quote: The GRE is NOT required to apply.

gre_subject.value: Subject tests are not required but may be included.
gre_subject.quote: GRE subject tests are NOT required for admissions. However, if you have taken a related subject test, you can include it in your application.

fee_waiver.value: The GRIT application feedback programme (deadline October 30) includes an MSU application fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: as well as an MSU application fee waiver

supervisor.value: Admitted students explore labs through rotations in the first two semesters.
supervisor.quote: while you explore research possibilities through laboratory rotations

funding.value: Every admitted BMS student gets a graduate assistantship with stipend, tuition and health insurance.
funding.quote: All students admitted in the BMS program are provided a graduate assistantship that includes a stipend for living expenses, academic fees, tuition and health insurance.

entry_route.value: Successful applicants typically hold a four-year bachelor's degree with math and science coursework.
entry_route.quote: Four-year bachelor's degree that includes coursework that demonstrates proficiency in math and science

notes: One gateway application for six doctoral programs: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology, Cell & Molecular Biology, Genetics & Genome Sciences, Microbiology & Molecular Genetics, Molecular/Cellular/Integrative Physiology, Pharmacology & Toxicology. Fee ($75) stated on this page.
